meta.name: image-to-video
meta.description: Animate any still image on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right i2v model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks HappyHorse 1.0 I2V (Arena #1, native audio, identity preservation) for general animations, Wan 2.7 with `audio_url` for custom-voiceover lip-sync, or Seedance 2.0 Pro for multi-modal animation from image + reference video + reference audio. Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the caller gets sharper output without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/image-to-video` (or endpoint variant) through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image to video", "image-to-video", "i2v", "animate image", "make this move", or any explicit ask to turn a still into video.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态图片变成动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把一张图片变成有动作的视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any still image into an animated video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to animate a still image into a video

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你的需求自动选择最合适的模型，把你的静态图片变成动画视频。你可以让它做人物肖像动画、产品展示、或者给图片配上自定义语音并让嘴型同步。
howto.when: 当你提到“图片转视频”、“i2v”、“让图片动起来”等关键词时，Claude 会触发这个技能。

say.text: 把这张图片变成5秒的动画，镜头缓慢推进。
say.note: Claude 会使用 HappyHorse 模型生成动画。

say.text: 用这张图片和这段语音，生成一个说话的视频。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Wan 2.7 模型实现嘴型同步。

say.text: 用这张图片、参考视频和参考音频，合成一段多模态动画。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically selects the best model to animate your still image into a video. It can create portrait animations, product reveals, or lip-sync a custom voiceover to the image.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "image to video", "i2v", "animate image", or ask to turn a still into motion.

say_en.text: Turn this image into a 5-second animation with a slow camera push-in.
say_en.note: Claude will use the HappyHorse model to generate the animation.

say_en.text: Use this image and this audio to generate a talking-head video.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Wan 2.7 model for lip-sync.

say_en.text: Combine this image, reference video, and reference audio into a multi-modal clip.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Seedance 2.0 Pro model.
